records.name: Dandy Ernstfalls
records.biography_en: Considers sincerity most attractive when it has been properly accessorised. His green HyperNorm carnation makes an honest intention socially presentable. A dissonant card asks whether the flower needs the same introduction as the person. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aufrichtigkeit entspricht der gewählten Ausstattung.

variant_notes.note_en: Considers sincerity most attractive when it has been properly accessorised.

records.name: Lady Brackblob
records.biography_en: Can turn a question about luggage into a complete theory of social order. Her HyperNorm lorgnette inspects the pedigree of an inconvenient answer. A dissonant card asks whether the question also has acceptable parents. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Herkunft der Auskunft erscheint weiterhin unzureichend.

variant_notes.note_en: Can turn a question about luggage into a complete theory of social order.

records.name: Butler Gurkenmaß
records.biography_en: Maintains standards even when the refreshments have become evidence. His HyperNorm tray preserves three triangles against the collapse of an entire explanation. A dissonant card wonders whether hunger can outrank etiquette. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Gurke wurde den Umständen entsprechend korrekt aufgeteilt.

variant_notes.note_en: Maintains standards even when the refreshments have become evidence.

records.name: Findelin Handgepäck
records.biography_en: Has an excellent character reference and an inconvenient place of origin. Her HyperNorm handbag carries an origin that the forms cannot accommodate. A dissonant card offers an introduction without requesting a more respectable container. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Charakter ist einwandfrei. Das Gepäck bleibt erklärungsbedürftig.

variant_notes.note_en: Has an excellent character reference and an inconvenient place of origin.

records.name: Bunbury Beinaheanwesend
records.biography_en: Is expected elsewhere by somebody who has never had to exist. His HyperNorm ticket proves he is needed by an absence of his own invention. A dissonant card asks whether he might simply want a quiet afternoon. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die anderweitige Verpflichtung wird durch Nichtexistenz entlastet.

variant_notes.note_en: Is expected elsewhere by somebody who has never had to exist.

records.name: Epigrammatiker Nachsatz
records.biography_en: Makes the last line elegant enough to postpone the first honest answer. His empty HyperNorm speech bubble waits for a line polished beyond reproach. A dissonant card leaves an awkwardly sincere answer in the notebook. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Nachsatz vertagt die vorausgehende Offenheit mit Stil.

variant_notes.note_en: Makes the last line elegant enough to postpone the first honest answer.
